title: Determinantal-weight multiset
statement:
Let $k_0$ be a finite field of characteristic $p$, let $\ell\ne p$ be prime, and fix $\iota:\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf C$. Let $X_0$ be a normal geometrically connected curve over $k_0$, and let $V$ be a finite-dimensional Weil representation on $X_0$, in the sense of [def-wf-fundamental-representation]. Choose a composition series and its semisimplification $V^{\mathrm{ss}}$ as in [def-mg-weil-semisimplification].

The *determinantal-weight multiset* of $V$ is
$$
\bigl\{\!\bigl\{\operatorname{dw}_\iota(S): S\text{ a simple summand of }V^{\mathrm{ss}}\bigr\}\!\bigr\},
$$
where $\operatorname{dw}_\iota(S)$ is the determinantal weight of [def-wf-determinantal-weight], with one entry for every occurrence of $S$. This multiset is independent of the chosen composition series: the semisimplification is independent up to isomorphism by [lem-mg-semisimplification-independent], and its simple-summand multiset is the composition-factor multiset specified in [def-mg-weil-semisimplification].
